SELECT no.id AS id, no.order_no AS orderNo, nsr.requester AS requester, nsr.proc_no AS procNo, np.name AS productName, nsi.qty_box AS qtyBox, no.create_time AS createTime FROM newbie_order AS no INNER JOIN newbie_sample_request nsr ON no.req_id = nsr.id INNER JOIN newbie_sample_items nsi ON no.item_id = nsi.id INNER JOIN newbie_product np ON nsi.product_id = np.id
AND nsr.proc_no like CONCAT('%',#{searchDto.procNo},'%')
AND no.order_no like CONCAT('%',#{searchDto.orderNo},'%')
AND no.create_time >= #{searchDto.beginDate}
AND no.create_time <= #{searchDto.endDate}
AND no.is_deleted = 0 AND nsr.is_deleted = 0 AND nsi.is_deleted = 0 AND np.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY no.create_time desc
